features.description: README.md gains a 'Run your first volley' section between the existing Quickstart (steps 1-5) and 'Project layout'. Documents `--mode interactive|autonomous` (P0 plan-derived only), target_env semantics (`prod` blocks dispatch unless tier=p0), and the diminishing-returns gotcha (`--max-iterations 1` still allows iter 0 + iter 1). features.description: New CLI subcommand `python -m jarvis_orchestrate dispatch-from-plan <plan-id>`, dry-run unconditionally without `--confirm`. Behavior: (a) resolve plan dir against `./docs/plans/<plan-id>/`; refuse with clear error if missing or fails plan.schema.json validation; (b) load plan.md (incl. `## Target` markdown section via `plan_target.parse_target_section`) + features.json; (c) print pre-flight context block with 10 fields in order: resolved plan path, feature id targeted (default F001), tier (frontmatter), target_env (Target section), target_project (Target section), implementer agent default (plan.agents_required[0] unless --implementer overrides), auditor agent default (plan.agents_required[1] unless --auditor overrides), human_gates declared (frontmatter), loop_caps.max_iterations (frontmatter), current quota readiness (one of: ok / config_required / calibration_required / unit_mismatch / missing_state — derived via the F006 evaluator collect_agent_coverage; for OK, also include `claude=N% / codex=N%` summary line); (d) without `--confirm`, ALWAYS exit 0 after printing the block — no interactive prompt, no TTY-conditional dispatch. (e) with `--confirm`, validate quota readiness is `ok`, then call into supervisor.dispatch_volley directly with all forwarded kwargs (no subprocess; this is a thin in-process pre-flight wrapper that reuses the existing dispatch entry — same module, same enforcement, same evidence). Forwarded flags: `--feature`, `--implementer`, `--auditor`, `--max-iterations`, `--mode`. Quota-blocking states under `--confirm`: missing_state, CONFIG_REQUIRED, CALIBRATION_REQUIRED, UNIT_MISMATCH each exit 3 with a kind-specific remediation pointer (`quota-caps init`, `calibrate-claude`, `quota_caps.json edit`, `quota_check.py`). Dry-run prints the same readiness label without refusal. CLI-first design (not a skill) so the same primitive serves Plan B's Discord trigger and any future automation. Future `--ask` flag for interactive y/N prompt is explicitly deferred (D006). Exit codes: 0 = dry-run printed OR dispatch returned cleanly; 2 = plan resolution / schema validation error; 3 = `--confirm` blocked by quota readiness state.

features.acceptance: (1) `python -m jarvis_orchestrate dispatch-from-plan <plan-id>` without `--confirm` ALWAYS prints the 10-field pre-flight block and exits 0 without dispatching, regardless of TTY state. (2) Pre-flight block contains, in order: resolved plan path, feature id, tier, target_env, target_project, implementer default, auditor default, human_gates list, max_iterations, quota readiness label. (3) target_env and target_project are read from the plan.md `## Target` markdown section via `plan_target.parse_target_section` (NOT frontmatter; matches existing supervisor source-of-truth). (4) Quota readiness label is one of {ok, config_required, calibration_required, unit_mismatch, missing_state}, derived via `circuit_breakers.collect_agent_coverage`. For `ok`, an additional `claude=N% / codex=N%` line follows. (5) `--confirm` with readiness in {config_required, calibration_required, unit_mismatch, missing_state} exits 3 with a kind-specific one-line remediation: config_required → `python -m jarvis_orchestrate quota-caps init` (or edit if already present); calibration_required → `python -m jarvis_orchestrate calibrate-claude --dashboard-pct N`; unit_mismatch → edit `~/.jarvis/quota_caps.json`; missing_state → `python scripts/quota_check.py`. (6) `--confirm` with readiness=ok calls `supervisor.dispatch_volley` IN-PROCESS (no subprocess shell-out; same Python interpreter, same module). (7) Missing plan dir → exit 2 with clear error pointing at `docs/plans/`. (8) Schema-invalid plan → exit 2 with validator's error message. (9) `--feature`, `--implementer`, `--auditor`, `--max-iterations`, `--mode` propagate to `supervisor.dispatch_volley` kwargs verbatim (verified by spy/mock on dispatch_volley signature in tests). (10) Future interactive prompt mode deferred to optional `--ask` flag (D006). (11) All existing orchestrate test modules + 8+ new dispatch-from-plan tests pass.
